accepted.quote: H.R. 6553 would reduce the safeguards for some of the largest banks, including guardrails that could have prevented three of the largest bank failures in U.S. history in 2023 when Silicon Valley Bank and other regional banks failed.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the bill for weakening enhanced prudential standards, indicating support for strong bank safeguards.
